title: Standardize audit event_type naming and update REQ-004-022 enumeration
description:
Audit event_type values currently mix dot-style (vm.create, vm.start) with kebab-style (vm-prune), creating inconsistency for downstream consumers. Standardize on one convention across all audit emissions and update the REQ-004-022 enumeration in the spec to reflect the chosen names.

Includes auditing all current call sites that emit audit events and aligning the spec's authoritative list. Surfaced as arch-SF-1 in Wave 4 review.

title: Add provision log writer error-swallowing test
description:
Add a test that exercises the provision log writer with an io.Writer that returns errors, asserting that write errors are either propagated or logged (per the chosen contract) and never silently swallowed.

Surfaced as qa-SF-7 in Wave 4 review.

title: Snapshot restore: include backup tag in apply-failure error message
description:
When snapshot restore's apply phase fails, the error returned to the user does not include the auto-created backup-snapshot tag. The operator needs that tag string to recover, so it must appear verbatim in the actionable error message.

Surfaced as critic-SF-1 in Wave 4 review.

title: Emit snapshot-skipped audit event when --no-snapshot is used
description:
When --no-snapshot is passed to a command that would normally auto-snapshot, no audit trail records that a snapshot was deliberately skipped. Emit a snapshot-skipped audit event so operators can see this in the log.

Surfaced as qa-SF-5 in Wave 4 review.

title: sd init: validate existing .sd.yaml on no-op; emit invalid_existing_config on parse failure
description:
When sd init runs against a repo that already has .sd.yaml, the no-op path should still parse and validate the existing file. If parsing fails, emit a distinct error code invalid_existing_config (rather than silently succeeding or producing a generic error) so callers can detect a broken config.

Surfaced as critic-SF-3 in Wave 4 review.

title: Flaky: TestProperty_CustomSessionNameOverridesDefault draws customName with sd- prefix
description:
internal/session/TestProperty_CustomSessionNameOverridesDefault (introduced in commit 5f03d8a) is flaky: the rapid generator can draw a customName starting with 'sd-', which the test assertion then forbids. The generator needs to exclude that prefix (or the assertion needs to be relaxed) so the property reflects the real invariant.

Pre-existing flake, surfaced during Wave 4 review. Priority P1 because it can fail CI runs unrelated to the change under test.

title: created_at serializes as zero value in sd list --json
description:
From E2E smoke test.

created_at field in sd list --json is 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z. Either persist on create or omit.

Acceptance criteria:
- created_at is persisted on sd create and survives across invocations.
- If unavailable, field omitted from JSON (omitempty).
- Test asserts non-zero value after create.

title: sd doctor does not detect missing Include config.d/* in ~/.ssh/config
description:
From E2E smoke test.

sd create warns about a missing 'Include config.d/*' line in ~/.ssh/config, but sd doctor does not check for it. Move the check into doctor (so users can run preflight).

Acceptance criteria:
- sd doctor scans ~/.ssh/config for the expected Include directive (or equivalent).
- Emits a fixable warning with the exact line to add.
- Both text and JSON output.
- Test with a temporary ssh config fixture.

title: sd init not idempotent — errors when .sd.yaml exists
description:
From E2E smoke test.

sd init errors instead of being a no-op when .sd.yaml already exists. Should print 'already initialized, use --force to overwrite' and exit 0.

Acceptance criteria:
- Re-running sd init on a directory with existing .sd.yaml prints the already-initialized message to stderr and exits 0.
- --force still overwrites.
- JSON output reflects the no-op state.
- Test for both code paths.

title: Module script failures don't surface stdout/stderr
description:
From E2E smoke test.

module "base" script[0] failed (exit 1) has no diagnostic info. Capture and emit script output on failure.

Acceptance criteria:
- Module runner captures stdout+stderr per script step.
- On failure, last N lines (or all) are surfaced in the error message and JSON error payload.
- Successful runs do not spam output unless --verbose.
- Test asserts captured output on a deliberately failing script.

title: No sd prune command — orphan VM state lingers after backend VM is gone
description:
From E2E smoke test.

Orphan VM state lingers in ~/.sd/vms/ after the backend VM is gone; sd list emits warnings with no remedy.

Acceptance criteria:
- New sd prune command removes orphan directories under ~/.sd/vms/ where backend has no matching VM.
- Supports --dry-run and --json.
- sd list warning text references sd prune as the remedy.
- Test with a fabricated orphan directory.

title: Wire auto-snapshot into sd provision (re-run case)
description:
Auto-snapshot scope extension. Today auto-snapshot fires on destroy; extend to provision re-runs.

Acceptance criteria:
- sd provision (when re-running on an already-provisioned VM) creates a snapshot tagged pre-provision-{ts} before applying modules.
- --no-provision-snapshot opts out.
- Snapshot failure is warn-not-fatal for this path (unlike destroy).
- Audit-logged.
- Test: provision twice, second run has a pre-provision snapshot.

title: Wire auto-snapshot into sd snapshot restore
description:
Before restoring to a prior snapshot, capture current state.

Acceptance criteria:
- sd snapshot restore <name> <tag> creates a snapshot tagged pre-restore-{ts} before restoring.
- --no-backup-snapshot opts out.
- Snapshot failure is warn-not-fatal for this path.
- Audit-logged.
- Test: restore, verify pre-restore snapshot exists.

title: Redact meta[error] in destroy and snapshot audit metadata
description:
Destroy and snapshot operations record the raw error string into audit meta["error"]. Errors from backend commands can embed credentials, tokens, or other sensitive arguments (e.g., from limactl command lines). Redact known-sensitive substrings before persisting to the audit log.

Surfaced as critic-SF-8 in Wave 4 review. Priority P1 because it is a potential credential-leak path.

title: Add rapid property test for created_at migration
description:
Add a pgregory.net/rapid property test covering the created_at field migration in VM config: for arbitrary pre-migration configs (with and without created_at, varying mtimes, varying file contents), the migration should produce a config whose created_at is monotonic, non-zero, and stable under re-migration.

Surfaced as qa-SF-1 in Wave 4 review.

title: ReadVMConfig mtime fallback: prefer statx BTIME on Linux when available
description:
ReadVMConfig falls back to mtime when no created_at is recorded. On Linux, prefer statx BTIME (birth time) when available — it more accurately reflects creation time and avoids drift when the config file is touched.

Surfaced as critic-SF-5 in Wave 4 review.

title: Assert backup_tag audit metadata in snapshot restore tests
description:
Extend snapshot restore tests to assert that the audit event for a restore records the backup_tag in its metadata. Currently the tag is created but no test pins it into the audit payload.

Surfaced as qa-SF-4 in Wave 4 review.

title: formatScriptFailure: cap tail output by per-line length and total bytes
description:
formatScriptFailure currently tails a fixed number of lines without limiting line length or total byte size. A single very long log line (or a tail of many long lines) can produce unbounded output. Add a per-line truncation cap and a total-byte cap.

Surfaced as critic-SF-7 in Wave 4 review.

title: Tighten pluralIES(0) contract
description:
pluralIES(0) currently returns the plural form, but the contract isn't documented and zero-case messaging varies by call site. Decide and document the zero-case behavior (likely plural, matching standard English) and add a test pinning it.

Surfaced as critic-SF-9 in Wave 4 review.

title: Make scriptLogTailLines configurable via Options
description:
The number of trailing log lines shown when a provisioning script fails is a hardcoded constant (scriptLogTailLines). Expose it as a field on the relevant Options struct so callers and config can override the default.

Surfaced as arch-SF-4 in Wave 4 review.

title: Make provision.log path configurable and add rotation; update REQ-006-005
description:
provision.log is currently written to a hardcoded path with no rotation or size cap. Add configurability for the path and a rotation strategy (size- or count-based) and update spec 006 REQ-006-005 to document the file location, file mode, and rotation behavior.

Surfaced as arch-SF-3 in Wave 4 review.

title: sd provision failure: show how to roll back using auto-snapshot tag
description:
When sd provision fails after taking an auto-snapshot, the error message should tell the user the exact command to roll back using that snapshot tag. Today the snapshot exists but the user has to discover it manually.

Surfaced as critic-SF-2 in Wave 4 review.

title: Add flag-registration test for snapshot restore --no-snapshot
description:
Add a unit test that asserts the --no-snapshot flag is registered on the snapshot restore command (Cobra flag-set assertion). This prevents accidental flag removal during refactor.

Surfaced as qa-SF-3 in Wave 4 review.

title: Spec amendments arising from Wave 4 review
description:
Bundle of spec edits surfaced by the Wave 4 review. Update the following:

- REQ-005-024: add idempotent-init acceptance criteria covering the existing-config validation path.
- REQ-004-019: add note about flag consolidation (which command-level flags supersede or duplicate others).
- REQ-004-022: document audit event_type naming convention and add vm-prune to the enumeration.
- REQ-006-005: document provision.log file location, file mode, and rotation behavior.

Each amendment should land with revision-history entries pointing back to the Wave 4 review artifacts.

title: Wire egress + dns-filter modules into default provisioning
description:
Spec REQ-004-006: default-deny is not satisfied. DefaultModuleNames = [base, ssh-hardening]; egress + dns-filter are opt-in, so a default sd create produces a VM that can reach anything.

Acceptance criteria:
- DefaultModuleNames includes dns-filter and egress (or documented network-hardening umbrella).
- --no-network-hardening flag opts out, recorded in audit log.
- Integration test: default VM, curl http://example.com returns connect-refused / DNS NXDOMAIN.
- Integration test: each domain in DefaultEgressAllowlist is reachable from a default VM.
- sd security status reflects default-deny: enabled.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-001.

title: Runtime credential path: keychain-backed read, transient host file at most
description:
Spec REQ-004-013: Anthropic key MUST come from host env/keychain/sd config — not a file. Today config.WriteCredentials persists GITHUB_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to $SD_HOME/vms/<name>/credentials.yaml in plaintext (mode 0600). Promote OQ-1 (keychain integration) to load-bearing.

Acceptance criteria:
- macOS: credentials backed by /usr/bin/security add-generic-password -s sd-<vmname>.
- Linux: secret-tool/libsecret with fallback to existing file behavior.
- sd token rotate writes to keychain; sd token list reads from keychain; sd connect reads from keychain for SendEnv injection.
- Existing credentials.yaml migrated automatically (backup .bak then delete).
- sd destroy removes both keychain entry and any leftover file.
- Test: after revoke, no value retrievable via either path.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-002.

title: Snapshot failure must abort destructive operations
description:
Spec REQ-004-019: Snapshot Creation Failure — Fatal (destructive op MUST NOT proceed). Current internal/cmd/destroy.go lines 111–115 logs a warning and proceeds.

Acceptance criteria:
- destroy.go returns ui.CLIError{Code: snapshot_failed, ...} and exits 1 when SnapshotCreate fails (unless --no-snapshot).
- JSON output: {error: snapshot_failed, reason: insufficient_disk_space, operation: destroy, aborted: true}.
- New sd reset <name> command (or extend existing) wired to same pre-snapshot path.
- Unit test with backend stub returning ErrSnapshotFailed.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-003.

title: Audit-log coverage: snapshot, config, disconnect events
description:
REQ-004-022 enumerates events that MUST be logged: snapshot-create, snapshot-restore, config-change, disconnect. LogEvent absent in snapshot.go, config.go, config_egress.go. No disconnect hook in connect.go.

Acceptance criteria:
- runSnapshotCreate/Restore/Delete emit LogEvent (snapshot.create/restore/delete) with tag metadata.
- runConfigSet (and config egress add/remove) emit event=config.change with key path (no value if sensitive).
- runConnect emits event=disconnect when SSH process returns, with duration metadata.
- All LogEvent calls feed the hash chain.
- Test asserts presence of each event after invocation.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-004.

title: Live egress allowlist updates without VM restart
description:
REQ-004-008: Adding an egress rule post-creation MUST update the VM firewall without restart. Today sd config egress add updates host config only.

Acceptance criteria:
- sd config egress add <vm> <domain> invokes backend Exec that appends server=/<domain>/<upstream> to /etc/dnsmasq.d/sd-egress.conf and reloads; resolves and appends ACCEPT rule to sd-egress chain before trailing DROP.
- Symmetric remove.
- sd security status --json reflects new domain immediately.
- Integration test: add domain, curl from VM succeeds without sd restart.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-005.

title: Doctor + CLI surfacing of the security model
description:
REQ-004-001 references threat model in CLI help. REQ-004-027/029/030 each include sd doctor warns... — verify or implement.

Acceptance criteria:
- sd help security page (Cobra long help on security group or sd security help) summarizes threat model + layered defenses.
- sd create --help includes a one-paragraph Default security posture stanza.
- sd doctor adds checks: ~/.git-credentials presence (REQ-004-030); SSH fragment missing ForwardAgent no (REQ-004-027); project .sd/config.yaml with security.* keys (REQ-004-029).
- Each warning printed as text and JSON.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-006.

title: Git credential cache prevention inside VM
description:
REQ-004-030 fully MISSING. Spec mandates clearing credential.helper to empty and removing ~/.git-credentials.

Acceptance criteria:
- New provisioning step (extend base or new git-hardening module) as dev user: git config --global --unset-all credential.helper, then git config --global credential.helper ""; delete ~/.git-credentials if present (log warning event).
- sd doctor (or sd security status) flags ~/.git-credentials if it re-appears.
- Test: provision VM with pre-seeded ~/.git-credentials, verify removed.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-007.

title: Schema-driven checksum verification for downloads
description:
REQ-004-028: module YAML schema drives verification, not inline shell. Today checksums are duplicated in checksums: field AND inline echo ... sha256sum -c -; drift is silent.

Acceptance criteria:
- Module loader emits verification step from checksums: automatically. Remove hand-rolled sha256sum lines in golang.yaml, github-cli.yaml, rust.yaml, claude-code.yaml, codex.yaml, gemini-cli.yaml.
- Mismatch aborts with spec error checksum_mismatch.
- sd doctor warns on user-defined modules with downloads but no checksums.
- Property test: corrupt one byte, expect fatal.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-008.

title: sd reset <name> command
description:
REQ-004-019 mentions sd reset as a destructive op that MUST pre-snapshot. No such command exists.

Acceptance criteria:
- sd reset <name> stops, reverts to most-recent or named snapshot, restarts.
- Pre-snapshot before reset (same code path as destroy).
- Audit-logged.
- Documented in --help.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-009.

title: GitHub bot identity wiring
description:
REQ-004-016 (SHOULD). config set github.bot_account and GIT_AUTHOR_* env injection not implemented.

Acceptance criteria:
- Config key github.bot_account accepted and stored.
- sd connect injects GIT_AUTHOR_NAME, GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL, GIT_COMMITTER_NAME, GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL (from config) via SendEnv.
- sshd AcceptEnv extended to include GIT_*.
- Test asserts env propagation into VM session.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-010.

title: Branch-protection guidance in sd token github setup
description:
REQ-004-017. sd token github setup output lists scopes only; spec wants explicit branch-protection guidance + docs page.

Acceptance criteria:
- sd token github setup text and JSON include a branch_protection_recommendations section.
- New doc docs/security/github-setup.md covering recommended branch-protection settings.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-011.

title: Audit log path configurability + sink for write failures
description:
REQ-004-021: sd config set audit.log_path <path> and graceful warning on write failure.

Acceptance criteria:
- sd config set audit.log_path /tmp/foo.log honored on next invocation.
- Permission-denied on log file emits spec-defined JSON warning and continues.
- Test using chmod-stripped temp file.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-012.

title: CI/hook diff JSON warning field
description:
REQ-004-018: changed CI/hook files surfaced via structured warning, including untracked files.

Acceptance criteria:
- sd diff <name> --json returns { ci_changes: [...], warnings: [{code: ci_file_changed, ...}] }.
- Coverage includes untracked files (status ??).
- Text output prefixes such lines with WARNING:.

Source: docs/security-004-revival-audit.md SEC-013.

title: Amend spec 002 — add sd ensure / init / guide / quick-start commands + Getting Started group
description:
Spec 002 (CLI) missing entries for newer commands. Blocks 009/010 review.

Acceptance criteria:
- specs/002-*.md adds sd ensure, sd init, sd guide, sd quick-start sections.
- New Getting Started group documented.
- Revision history updated; status set to review.
- Required to unblock spec-review-batch-2 and batch-4 (009/010).

title: Amend spec 004 — DNS filtering details, sshd cross-ref, crates.io egress, fix sd repair ref
description:
Targeted amendments to specs/004-security.md.

Acceptance criteria:
- REQ-004-025: DNS filtering details (dnsmasq config, NXDOMAIN behavior, address=/#/ catch-all) expanded.
- REQ-004-026: cross-reference to sshd hardening module.
- Default egress allowlist adds crates.io.
- Fix dangling sd repair reference (rename to actual command or remove).
- Revision history updated.

title: Walk specs 001/003/005 through 3-agent review (Batch 1)
description:
Spec process. Run 001-architecture, 003-vm-lifecycle, 005-config (or current numbers) through architect/critic/qa review until approved.

Acceptance criteria:
- All 3 review artifacts written for each spec under tests/reviews/ or specs/reviews/.
- All must-fix issues resolved.
- Status set to approved in each spec frontmatter.
- Revision history updated.

title: Walk specs 002/004/007 through review (Batch 2, after amendments)
description:
Batch 2 review after amendments to 002 and 004 land.

Acceptance criteria:
- 3-agent review for 002, 004, 007.
- Reviews written to tests/reviews/.
- Status approved on each.

title: Walk spec 006 through review (Batch 3)
description:
Batch 3.

Acceptance criteria:
- 3-agent review for spec 006.
- Reviews written to tests/reviews/.
- Status approved.

title: Walk specs 009/010 through review (Batch 4, after 002 amend)
description:
Batch 4. Depends on spec-002-amend-getting-started landing first.

Acceptance criteria:
- 3-agent review for 009, 010.
- Reviews written to tests/reviews/.
- Status approved.

title: Add rapid property test: prune never touches a live VM
description:
Add a pgregory.net/rapid property test asserting that across arbitrary mixes of live, stopped, and orphaned VMs, sd prune never deletes a VM whose backend status is live/running. This protects the most important safety invariant of prune.

Surfaced as qa-SF-2 in Wave 4 review.

title: Add list-overlay negative test for malformed VM config
description:
Add a negative test exercising sd list with a malformed VM config file in the overlay set. The list command should report the malformed entry without crashing and without skipping valid entries.

Surfaced as qa-SF-8 in Wave 4 review.

title: Add unified backend.AutoSnapshotTag(op, name) helper
description:
Auto-snapshot tag construction is duplicated across backend operations (destroy, provision, restore). Introduce backend.AutoSnapshotTag(op, name) as the single source of truth for tag formatting so all call sites produce identical, parseable tags.

Surfaced as arch-SF-5 in Wave 4 review.

title: Deduplicate orphan VM detection logic between list.go and prune.go
description:
Orphan-detection logic (a VM directory present in Lima but not in sd config, or vice versa) is currently implemented twice — once in internal/cmd/list.go and once in internal/cmd/prune.go. Extract a shared helper so both paths use a single canonical implementation.

Surfaced as arch-SF-2 in Wave 4 review.
